description: Advance the production identity and banner to Release 1259 Mara Field Capability Discovery.

replacements.old:
"ZORK I: The Great Underground Empire
Mara Causal Biography & Shared Danger Release 1258

Mara can now carry a bounded causal biography through one real Dam hazard:
  exact field rope, one explicit promise, persistent injury, reciprocal rescue,
  and a private discovery. Her later ladder decision follows named reasons rather
  than a global relationship score while canonical Dam survival stays authoritative."
replacements.new:
"ZORK I: The Great Underground Empire
Mara Field Capability Discovery Release 1259

Mara's existing survey knowledge becomes capability biography through authored
recovery, a River Frigid pendulum traversal, deliberate movement reuse, and
acoustic ranging that she first discovers and later intentionally repeats.
No XP, perk menu, generic skill engine, traversal AI, or puzzle-solving companion
is introduced; body, equipment custody, environment, and lived history stay authoritative."
